name: congoforce
description: Software factory for Claude Code: a requirement file in, a tested pull request out. Two human gates, frozen acceptance tests, a deterministic implement/verify loop. Python and JS/TS.

max_iterations.title: Max implement/verify iterations
max_iterations.description: Loop cap before CongoForce stops and asks you (a repo's .congoforce/config.toml overrides it).

confirm_before_push.title: Confirm before push
confirm_before_push.description: Show the PR body and wait for your yes before pushing the branch and opening the PR.

run_mode.title: Run mode
run_mode.description: foreground or background. background runs the implementer and verifier as background agents after Gate 2.

command_timeout.title: Command timeout (seconds)
command_timeout.description: Upper bound for every install, lint, build or test command the helper runs.

default_model.title: Default agent model
default_model.description: Optional model alias for all six agents (opus, sonnet, haiku, fable). Leave empty to inherit the session model. Spec and build models below override it for their roles.

spec_model.title: Spec model
spec_model.description: Model alias for the spec roles: requirements, product-spec, tech-spec and test-author (e.g. opus). Empty = default model.

build_model.title: Build model
build_model.description: Model alias for the implementer and verifier (e.g. sonnet). Empty = default model. Per-role models go in .congoforce/config.toml [models].
